name: 🛫 Build a Plane Tycoon!
desc:
✈️ Welcome to Build a Plane Tycoon! In this experience, you build numerous planes in a massive factory. With each one you complete, you can even fly! Fly to other friends' islands and more!

We have just released Plane Tycoon 2!
https://www.roblox.com/games/74168617922066/Plane-Tycoon-2

⌛This game is currently under development. More features will be coming in the future

🤔Want to submit ideas, hear about the latest news, updates, and more? Make sure you join the group! 
https://www.roblox.com/groups/4413376/Split-Second-Studios#!/about

🛠️Update🛠️
- New monetization (due to recent updates by Roblox)
- Notifications for in-game rewards

Build a Plane Tycoon, by Split Second Studios

Compatible with all devices.
